bio: The Green House Hotel is an exclusive 2 rosette 4-star retreat, nestled in picturesque Dorset. This beautiful boutique hotel lives and breathes sustainability, everything about the hotel is green.  The chic setting of the hotel champions environmental responsibility. The Green House Bournemouth offers a lush, natural hideaway, perfect for Afternoon Tea.  Passionate about using fresh, local, and seasonal ingredients, their pastry chef makes all the pastries to order so you can be sure your treat will always reflect the seasons.  The Green House Hotel offers a toast to true British history. The glamorous bar at The Green House restaurant is where the traditional Afternoon Tea (High Tea) is served. Alternatively, the expansive gardens on the hotel grounds offer a wonderful spot for Afternoon Tea on a beautiful sunny day.
